idea-plugin.name: Integrated AI Workbench
idea-plugin.description:
Integrated AI Workbench is an experimental, local-first AI development plugin for IntelliJ IDEA.

The plugin provides an interface for registering local GGUF model profiles, selecting Markdown-defined agents, supplying controlled project context, and executing local inference workflows.

Integration with permitted IntelliJ MCP tools, structured output validation, and model evaluation is under active development and verification.

The core architecture is designed to operate locally without requiring cloud AI subscriptions.
